mismatch.message: The saved baseline first differs at step 166 in the clerical blindness spell.

summary: The saved admitted baseline matches 166/724 screens before the first difference at step 166; RNG first diverges later at step 188. In upstream mcastu.c:mcast_blind_you, C prints the scales message, applies blindness through make_blinded(Half_spell_damage ? 100L : 200L, FALSE), and conditionally reports vision clearing. The JS mcast_spell dispatcher currently records note_unported('mcastu.c mcast_blind_you') for MCAST_BLIND_YOU, so this existing C body is skipped. This is a bounded missing-body and dispatcher-wiring divergence, not a whole mcastu.c port.

source.branch: mcast_spell dispatches MCAST_BLIND_YOU to mcast_blind_you with dmg set to zero. mcast_blind_you runs only when the hero is not Blinded: it obtains eyecount(gy.youmonst.data), prints 'Scales cover your %s!', calls make_blinded(Half_spell_damage ? 100L : 200L, FALSE), then says vision clears if Blind is still false; otherwise it reports impossible. JS already has an async dispatcher and an explicit gap at the same arm, but no helper body.
callers: C mcastu.c:castmu calls mcast_spell for both AD_SPEL and AD_CLRC attacks; JS castmu already awaits mcast_spell.

C mcastu.c:mcast_spell calls mcast_blind_you then sets dmg to zero, preserving its trailing mdamageu guard; JS dispatcher likewise supports awaited effect handlers and clears result damage by leaving resultDmg at zero.
dependencies: The consumed make_blinded effect is already ported in js/potion.js and takes the same state/environment; the dispatcher and caller are already async.

body_part is already ported in js/polyself.js and makeplural in js/fruit.js. C eyecount is the mondata.h macro: no eyes => 0, cyclops/floating eye => 1, otherwise 2; equivalent eye-count logic is already present in potion.js:make_blinded for body-part pluralization.
The separate MCAST_INSECTS arm remains an unrelated explicit gap.

evidence: Saved admitted baseline challenges/evaluations/baseline-78195d815-v54.json records 166/724 screens and 660/724 cursors before mismatch, with a later RNG divergence at index 2520 / step 188; error is null. Canonical manifest digest is cc258ba889b65b063f34199074d3313017b5d89ce3c175bb5443889ef9713e8e and the case recording digest is ddd5bb772fb07087c96ccd654edccd8ce96fc0b118cc7038c4317fbf8a64704a.
The admitted manifest identifies step 166 as mcastu.c:cast_spell MCAST_BLIND_YOU -> mcast_blind_you and explains that the missing scales/Blind-state effect precedes the later RNG consequences.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/mcastu.c:mcast_blind_you (729-742) defines the full effect; mcast_spell dispatches MCAST_BLIND_YOU at 875-877 and zeroes damage. JS mcastu.js has a matching async dispatcher arm but calls recordMcastGap('mcastu.c mcast_blind_you').

Production runtime entry is the monster AD_CLRC/AD_SPEL castmu branch -> mcast_spell -> mcast_blind_you. Existing make_blinded is the called state/vision effect; no new helper or return-valued dependency is needed.
